$AMAT: profit is growing faster than sales — revenue +53% to $10.4B, operating margin 35.1% (preliminary). Q4 operating profit grew faster than expenses. 👇 #earnings #semiconductors

$ANG-PD: operating profit grew faster than sales — revenue $1.7B (+4% Y/Y) with a 71.6% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #insurance
$ADIG: sales grew but costs surged following its spin-off — Q3 revenue $1.3B (+9% Y/Y) with a net loss of −$655M. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$MWH: New Construction drove 96% of the growth, pushing Q3 revenue up 65% Y/Y to $1.2B. Operating profit margin reached 11.4%. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$FLO: cash came in ahead of profit — operating cash flow $78M, 545% of net earnings. Q3 revenue $1.2B (-5% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #consumer
